title: SIP: Fix parsing Security Mechanism
description:
Before the tvb_find_uint8 changes, this used the property that
the returned offset when not found was -1 to always enter the
loop. The control flow is simpler and clearer with a do..while
loop. We also don't need to handle the failure condition, because
it correctly sets the offset to the line end offset in that case.

Also, inside dissect_sip_sec_mechanism, a test was flipped.

Fixup c8153f190f795bce8120c3c4ec12ec28da7ccff3
